title: Synthesis, molecular modeling Insights, and anticancer assessment of novel polyfunctionalized Pyridine congeners.
authors: Abouelenein, Mohamed G; El-Rashedy, Ahmed A; Awad, Hanem M; El Farargy, Ahmed F; Nassar, Ibrahim F; Nassrallah, Amr
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成并评估新型吡啶衍生物的抗癌活性，涉及分子对接与MD模拟但针对蛋白质-小分子（ATP位点）而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: The present study describes synthesizing a novel series of polyfunctionalized pyridine congeners 1-18 and assessed for cytotoxic efficacies versus HCT-116, MCF-7, and HepG-2 among one non-cancerous BJ-1 human normal cell. Most compounds were precisely potent anticancer candidate drugs. The molecular impact of the most active compounds 9, 10, 11, 13, 15, and 17 was evaluated after MCF-7 treatment. The gene expression of pro- and ant-apoptosis markers P53, Bax, Caspase-3 and Bcl-2 as well as VEGFR-2 and HER2 were determined. Compounds 13 and 15 induced upregulation of pro-apoptosis of P53, Bax, Caspase-3 and downregulation of anti-apoptosis Bcl-2 gene. However, compound 15 showed higher effect compared to 13 and respective control. Moreover, a slight reduction in HER2 gene expression was detected due to compound 15 treatment, while VEGFR-2 gene was upregulated. In agreement, the immunoblotting analysis showed higher accumulation of P53, Bax, Caspase-3 proteins and of decrease the Bcl-2 protein levels. Furthermore, docking studies united with molecular dynamic simulation exposed compounds 13 and 15 fitting in the middle of the active site at the interface linking the ATP binding site and the allosteric hydrophobic binding pocket. Finally, we performed Petra/Osiris/ Molinspiration (POM) analysis for the newly synthesized compounds. The evaluation of primary in silico parameters revealed significant differences among individual polyfunctionalized pyridine compounds, highlighting the most promising candidates. These preliminary results may help in coordinating and initiating other research projects focused on polyfunctionalized pyridine compounds, especially those with predicted bioactivity, low toxicity, optimal ADME parameters, and promising perspectives.
abstract_zh: 本研究描述了一系列新型多官能化吡啶类化合物1-18的合成，并评估了其对HCT-116、MCF-7和HepG-2以及一种非癌性人正常细胞BJ-1的细胞毒性效力。大多数化合物是精确有效的抗癌候选药物。在MCF-7处理后，评估了最活跃化合物9、10、11、13、15和17的分子影响。测定了促凋亡和抗凋亡标志物P53、Bax、Caspase-3以及Bcl-2，以及VEGFR-2和HER2的基因表达。化合物13和15诱导了促凋亡基因P53、Bax、Caspase-3的上调，并下调了抗凋亡基因Bcl-2。然而，化合物15的效果高于13和相应对照组。此外，化合物15处理导致HER2基因表达轻微降低，而VEGFR-2基因上调。与此一致，免疫印迹分析显示P53、Bax、Caspase-3蛋白积累增加，Bcl-2蛋白水平降低。此外，分子对接研究结合分子动力学模拟显示，化合物13和15适配于ATP结合位点与变构疏水结合口袋之间界面的活性位点中心。最后，我们对新合成的化合物进行了Petra/Osiris/Molinspiration (POM)分析。初步的计算机模拟参数评估显示，各多官能化吡啶化合物之间存在显著差异，突出了最有前景的候选物。这些初步结果可能有助于协调和启动其他专注于多官能化吡啶化合物的研究项目，特别是那些具有预测生物活性、低毒性、最佳ADME参数和良好前景的化合物。
